jobs.title: Revenue Product Lead
jobs.description:
ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

What you’ll do:

As the Product Leader for Revenue & Monetization, you’ll set and own the vision for how ClassDojo sustainably grows its consumer business. You’ll lead the charge on monetization strategy across our product ecosystem—creating experiences that drive meaningful revenue while deepening value for millions of families around the world. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role where you’ll operate at both strategic and tactical levels: guiding the roadmap, developing new business models, diving into the details of experiments, and scaling what works. You’ll partner closely with co-founders, executives, and cross-functional leaders across engineering, design, data, and marketing to align on bold goals and deliver fast. You’ll be a hands-on builder and thoughtful leader—someone who drives clarity in ambiguity, inspires high standards, and raises the bar for both product quality and business results. Above all, you’ll bring a founder’s mindset to growing one of the most loved consumer education products in the world.

You will be a match if:

 - 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading and growing high-performing product teams

 - Proven track record of driving significant revenue impact through consumer monetization products—especially subscriptions, pricing, and paywall design

 - Experience in world-class consumer tech environments, with a strong bias for product quality, innovation, and user-centricity

 - Demonstrated strategic thinking and problem-solving excellence—able to break down complex, ambiguous challenges and translate insights into actionable product and business strategies

 - Hands-on and execution-oriented: balances high-level strategy with a willingness to roll up sleeves and drive details

 - Founder mindset: relentless, scrappy, and comfortable operating without perfect resources; thrives in dynamic, early-stage or high-growth environments

 - Clear, concise, and persuasive communicator—both in writing and in person—with experience influencing execs and aligning cross-functional teams

 - Strong judgment and high standards across product, people, and business outcomes

 - Deep collaboration experience with engineering, design, data, and marketing to drive monetization strategy and execution

You might be a good fit if:

 - Experience building and scaling consumer subscription businesses
   Background in early-stage startups or as a founder/operator

 - Deep understanding of consumer psychology and behavioral economics as it relates to monetization, conversion, and retention

 - Success scaling monetization internationally or across new platforms

 - Demonstrated ability to coach and develop PMs and cross-functional partners

 - Experience setting vision and roadmap for complex systems and driving alignment across stakeholders

 - Track record of accelerating pace and raising the bar for speed, experimentation, and scrappy execution

 - Familiarity with pricing experimentation, bundling strategies, or multi-tier subscription models

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. What you’ll do:

As a Product Manager focused on monetization, you’ll own one of the most important growth levers for ClassDojo: building a consumer revenue engine that feels deeply aligned with user value. You’ll design and scale monetization experiences that millions of families choose to pay for—and love using. Working closely with design, engineering, data, and marketing, you’ll craft and iterate on high-quality experiments that drive both user delight and business impact. You’ll use a mix of research, behavioral insight, data, and intuition to shape our subscription experience, pricing, bundling, positioning, and conversion flows. You’ll operate with high autonomy and ownership, partnering directly with co-founders and product leaders to define and deliver on long-term strategy. This role is about going deep on product craft, working across disciplines to deliver creative, elegant solutions to user problems—then scaling them globally to support our mission of helping every child reach their full potential.

You will be a match if:

 - 5+ years of growth product management experience shipping high-quality, at-scale consumer products across at least two companies—one of which had >1M users and one that was not a late-stage company

 - Deep monetization experience: proven success driving revenue growth through creative, user-centric monetization strategies on consumer products

 - Strategic product thinker with exceptional product intuition—able to uncover user needs, generate insights, and craft novel product solutions that drive business impact

 - Experience working on complex consumer ecosystems such as social platforms, marketplaces, or similarly multi-sided products

 - Strong analytical mindset: comfortable exploring data, validating hypotheses, and shaping strategy using both qualitative and quantitative signals

 - Track record of high ambition and outsize business impact—able to thrive in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership: collaborates effectively with engineering, design, data, marketing, and leadership to drive alignment and execution

 - Strong communication and storytelling skills, both written and verbal—able to clearly articulate product vision, strategy, and trade-offs

You might be a good fit if:

 - Experience leading monetization work in social or marketplace products

 - Background in both 0-to-1 and growth-stage product development; ideally has seen consumer products through multiple life stages

 - Experience growing consumer products in international markets

 - Strong track record of influence and leadership without authority; has coached or mentored other PMs

 - Experience working at a high-bar, product-driven company with a culture of excellence

 - Familiarity with pricing, payments infrastructure, or revenue optimization techniques

 - Demonstrated ability to act as a thought partner to execs on product and revenue strategy

 - Comfort navigating ambiguity and scaling efforts from scratch with autonomy and ownership

jobs.title: Growth Product Lead, Kids
jobs.description:
ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.




ABOUT CLASSDOJO & DOJO ISLANDS

 - Monsterverse is our virtual world for kids. Dojo Islands is where they build, play, and connect with classmates and friends.

 - The limit on growth has flipped. Revenue isn't it anymore; the size of the Islands user base is. 10M+ kids receive class points each week, and most have never installed the app.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

We're hiring a product leader for the Monsterverse to own kid growth — growing kid users of Dojo Islands. This means running the product team that owns top-of-funnel growth for Dojo Islands and driving the cross-company roadmap to grow Monthly Active Kids (our core company metric is Monthly Active Connected Families, where families are Parents and/or Kids). You'll work closely with our co-founders, leaders, and cross-functional teams to invent and test long-term ideas, at both a strategic and tactical level.

 - The kid growth funnel end-to-end: awareness, install, activation, and early retention for Dojo Islands

 - The cross-company roadmap for Monthly Active Kids, coordinating across the flagship app, school network, and Islands

 - A small, high-leverage product team — setting direction, shipping fast, and learning faster

 - A direct working relationship with co-founders on long-term growth strategy




YOU WILL BE A MATCH IF:

 - You've owned a top-line growth metric end-to-end. You've led initiatives that measurably moved DAU/WAU, install conversion, or retention on a consumer product. You can clearly articulate before → after.

 - You have gaming and/or kid-product experience — or a close equivalent. You've shipped at scale in games, social, or gamified products. You've lived in the activation and retention trenches and know how to find the fun.

 - You operate at both the strategic and the detail level. You drive a cross-org roadmap and write your own SQL. You set direction, then go get into the details.

 - You're self-sufficient with data. You can write queries, build dashboards, and analyze funnels without dedicated support.

 - You're a structured problem-solver in ambiguity. You break complex problems down, synthesize quant and qual, and produce simple, actionable plans.

 - AI is core to how you work, not a side tool. You've built it into your product process and your own workflow. We'll probe on this — it's important to us.

 


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - Founder or early-stage startup experience (pre-Series B). Operating in the $1M–$10M revenue phase builds the right reflexes.

 - Experience with kids' products, consumer social, or platforms with T&S / trust and safety considerations.

 - Experience with cross-functional growth loops — viral mechanics, referral systems, or in-product distribution.
